path.id: Visitors explore and linger within a woven space, creating a memorable brand experience that sets Samsung apart.
A Distinctive Path That Sparks Curiosity
Spaces That Invite Visitors to Stay
Inspired by woven patterns, the circulation path gradually reveals new spaces and products, encouraging visitors to explore.
Naturally formed pockets within the layout offer comfortable places to pause, making time spent in the space an integral part of the Samsung experience.
